# Approval workflow readout

## Approval timeouts

> When it times out halfway through the approval, I have to start the whole request again from the first screen. — P3

> I end up refreshing the approval page every few minutes just to see whether anything has moved. — P3

## Visibility

> The approval timeout is the single biggest blocker to my whole workflow and nobody will own it. — P3

> So the thing is, we never really trusted the numbers on the shared dashboard because nobody owned them. — P7

40% of participants mentioned visibility as their top issue.

## Speed

Everyone wants this to be faster.

3 of 8 participants said the flow takes more than a day.

## Recommendations

We should rebuild the approval screen as a single page.
